messages:
Maria Santos: @olga need quick deal-desk ok for a POC with a FlexPool metered commit. Customer wants a 3-month commit, roughly 4x H100 equivalent (they'll accept A100 mix), and the ability to burst up to ~2x baseline during weekdays. Any blockers?
Olga Petrova: Maria, can you paste the proposed numbers? committed units, list price, requested discount? We need ARR impact to spin up a provisional quote.
Maria Santos: Baseline commit = 4 units; list rate referenced (internal) <pricing.rw/redacted>. Asking for 30% off for POC, plus temporary burst allowance at 1.8x for 30 days. Customer also needs VPC/private control plane (HIPAA).
Kevin Li: From SE side: burst is doable but operationally expensive. Autoscale can allow 2x, but must cap at pool capacity. Mixed-GPU pools are required if they want H100 perf with A100 fallback — pricing differs per GPU. Latency SLA likely loosens during peak.
Kevin Li: Quick config note:
```
Committed: 4 units (mixed A100/H100)
Burst cap: 2x for 30d
Warm reserve: +8% nodes to avoid cold starts
Metric: minute-level burst billing
```
Maria Santos: Noted. @Harry can sales accept 30% concession for an enterprise POC?
Harry Kim: 30% is steep for metered commits. Typical POC concession is 15-20%. Need deal desk / revops sign-off.
Olga Petrova: If we move to 25% we need clear upsell signals + legal OK for temporary burst carveout. Also mark any ops uplift as one-time non-recurring fee.
Maria Santos: Customer: Veridian Health (enterprise). Requires HIPAA, SSO, and VPC private control plane. They project ~1.6x average burst during heavy hours.
DealDeskBot: New approval request created: DD-2026-1842 by Maria Santos. Link: <internal/dd/DD-2026-1842> :hourglass: 
Olga Petrova: I spun up a provisional quote with 25% concession and an explicit burst pricing line: baseline rate + burst premium = 40% of baseline for hours over baseline, capped at 2x for max 30 days. Quote ID Q-5561.
Harry Kim: +1 on 25% if legal signs off. Add clause: burst billing measured per-minute, and auto-rollback to baseline after 30 days or on customer request. :white_check_mark:
Kevin Li: Technical caveat: to keep tail latency reasonable we need warm nodes reserved for burst which increases cost by ~8% — ops must accept a "burst reserve surcharge". Also mixed pool means throughput variance; include fallback to smaller model in SLO.
Olga Petrova: I'll include the "burst reserve surcharge" as a non-recurring line item for the POC and document it in the SOW.
Maria Santos: I'll update the customer and ask for an initialed SOW + security contact for the HIPAA checklist.
Harry Kim: Once SOW is signed, I'll greenlight internally. @DealDeskBot please escalate to RevOps for final sign-off and get legal looped.
DealDeskBot: Escalation sent to revops@redwood and legal@redwood. Approval thread created: <internal/dd/DD-2026-1842/approval>
Maria Santos: Thanks — if RevOps approves today we can provision early next week and schedule onboarding. :rocket:
Olga Petrova: FYI include explicit language: Dedicated pool will be mixed-GPU (A100/H100 fallback) — ops requires that for capacity headroom.
Kevin Li: Also add opt-out: if customer insists on guaranteed H100-only nodes we need a longer commit term and pricing uplift.
Maria Santos: Copy. I'll post the updated SOW link when ready and ping this thread.
Olga Petrova: Sounds good. Please attach the HIPAA addendum and the minute-level burst billing example in the SOW.
Maria Santos: Will do. Thanks team. :pray:
